# Pending changes (since patch 0020, 2026-11-23)

## 2026-11-24 - The web build starts, shows its sky and its loading
Asked: "web version in itchio is too slow it does not even start when i click start". Measured in Chromium (the web export served locally, frames counted from the page):
- The title froze for ~15 s (1-4 frames a second): CosmosWarm drew one of every 3D thing at the title to compile its shaders, and in a browser each compile stops the page for up to a second - Start game seemed dead. In a browser the title now only does the background loads (and the HUD's text); the shaders compile under the loading screen. Title at 60 FPS from the first second.
- The loading screen is hidden by design (the game shows as it's made - a second or two on the desktop); in a browser the world takes ~30 s, so there the screen and its bar show (LoadVeil).
- "Too many instances using shader instance variables" (492 errors at every load): in the Compatibility renderer each instance with instance uniforms takes 16 of 4096 slots - 256 instances in all - and the terrain had ~730 patches. In Compatibility the terrain has none now: each vertex's planet-local place from MODEL_MATRIX and the planet's inverse transform (set every frame before drawing - CosmosPlanet._pre_draw), "carves near" worked out per vertex, the dug ground marked in its UVs (y 1). Forward+ keeps one instance vec4 a patch (its centre and the carves flag - was three values). 0 errors now.
- The sky was black on planets in the browser: the atmosphere (and the vein hologram, and the underwater pass) read the depth buffer as Forward+'s 0..1 reversed depth; Compatibility's is OpenGL's -1..1 - converted under CURRENT_RENDERER now. Blue sky again.
Checked: the desktop game run with --rendering-method gl_compatibility (the web's renderer): sky, terrain, a dug trench, 0 errors; the web export in Chromium: title 60 FPS, game in, 60 FPS.
Files: scripts/world/models/cosmos_warm.gd, scripts/core/load_veil.gd, shaders/world/terrain.gdshader, scripts/world/space/cosmos_planet.gd, scripts/world/space/cosmos_voxels.gd, shaders/world/atmosphere.gdshader, shaders/world/vein_holo.gdshader, shaders/world/underwater.gdshaderinc; guide shots retaken.
